text:
emily_sales: FYI — HealthInsure (enterprise healthcare payer) forwarded a security questionnaire and asked for a POC: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, and a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) with air-gap option. They also want pricing for Dedicated + on-prem connector. timeline: want POC in ~3 weeks. Can SE confirm blockers?
rohit_se: On paper doable. Need clarity on: 1) domain ownership flow (they want cross-tenant SCIM for delegated admins), 2) SCIM delta intervals and provisioning volume, 3) SAML certificate rotation policy expectations. Also, do they require us to run HSM/KMS in their VPC or is customer KMS sufficient?
emily_sales: I'll ask them to confirm tenant counts and expected monthly MAU for token pricing. They said ~120k active users, 50k directory objects to sync.
laura_secmgr: Compliance flags: HIPAA + HITRUST scoping. We need BAA in contract before any PHI in logs. They require audit logs forwarded to their SIEM, immutability retention 7 years for certain events, and explicit key separation — customer-managed keys preferred. Also need proof of SOC2 + penetration test cadence.
rohit_se: For SCIM: delta patch approach will scale. If 50k objects and frequent changes, recommend SCIM bulk + incremental polling ~5m cadence. Note: SCIM rate limits on hosted plan — Dedicated removes those limits. For delegated admin mapping we support external group claims mapping to RBAC, but will need a mapping table in the POC.
dave_sol_eng: Quick config notes that might help the demo. Example SCIM PATCH we use to set role attributes:

```
PATCH /scim/v2/Users/{id}
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"],
  "Operations": [{
    "op": "Replace",
    "path": "roles",
    "value": ["clinical_viewer","claims_admin"]
  }]
}
```

SAML metadata we can upload programmatically, sample ACS URL: `https://private.healthinsure.redwood.example/saml/acs` — they want RelayState support. Certificate rotation: we support hot-swap with overlap window.
rohit_se: On private deployment: we can do a customer-managed control plane trigger or full on-prem node. For air-gapped, the on-prem package requires a 1-week install window and access to their infra team. For Dedicated sizing: recommended start = 2 x NVIDIA A10g equiv (for mixed generation models) for inference routing + 1 small control-plane VM. Pricing: I put a rough ballpark for POC (4 weeks) — $18k for Dedicated staging + one-time connector/setup $12k. Need finance to sign off.
emily_sales: Can you add a simple statement for the security questionnaire re: key handling so I can forward? Laura, do we need additional language?
laura_secmgr: Draft: "Customer-managed KMS is supported for Private. Keys never leave customer VPC; we offer HSM-backed envelopes for hosted with BYOK options." Also: "Audit logs are available via S3 export or syslog/Splunk forwarder; WORM retention can be configured via customer retention policies."
rohit_se: Two technical caveats to surface in presales: 1) SCIM deltas with delegated admin across multiple domains require deterministic conflict resolution rules (we prefer source-of-truth at IdP side), 2) If they insist on on-prem inference + air-gap for PHI, some advanced telemetry features (trace sampling) will be limited.
dave_sol_eng: For the POC checklist:
- collect SAML metadata (IdP cert, entityID, ACS, logout)
- SCIM service account + scopes (full write required for provisioning)
- sample RBAC mapping CSV (group -> role)
- network allowlist for connector IPs + proxy details
- KMS details + BAA signed
I'll drop a minimal config snippet (examples for SAML and SCIM) in the customer folder after this thread.
emily_sales: Thanks — I'll request the SAML metadata and a sample CSV for group->role mapping. Also asking them for a preferred POC window (they suggested Apr 13-24).
deploy-bot: ticket RED-35821 created for HealthInsure POC (owner: rohit_se) — docs: https://redwood.atlassian.example/RED-35821
emily_sales: @rohit_se can you confirm by EOD whether the $30k POC estimate is realistic? I'll flag to ENG/finance.
rohit_se: EOD confirm: yes that's a reasonable baseline for a 4-week end-to-end POC including Dedicated staging + connector + 2x support days of eng onsite/remote. If they want full on-prem inference nodes increases by ~$40k.
laura_secmgr: Also loop legal early for BAA and any data processing addenda. Health customers are picky.
emily_sales: Great. I'll send the questionnaire + request metadata. Will post replies here. :thumbsup:
